paragraphs: Abba of Sidon. The students of Rabbi Abba, and Abba of Sidon, in Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman’s name; Kohelet Rabbah on “A good name is better than good oil,” and Midrash Shmuel, chapter 23. And the students of Rabbi Immi.
